title: Release Runbook - ANRC Channel
body: For ANRC release 2.6.4, collect evidence from ticket `OES-1287` and `release-pipeline/release.json`, trigger a build, sign the canonical manifest, and publish to channel `anrc`. Customer validation is performed by polling `http://customer-app:7007/api/poll-now`.
